Definition: to prick up the ears, i.e. hearken
BiblicalUsage: To hearken is the word for listening that obeys: behold, to obey is better than sacrifice, and to hearken than the fat of rams; O that thou hadst hearkened to my commandments, then had thy peace been as a river. Daniel prays, O Lord, hearken and do, defer not, for thine own sake.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe hearkening is the whole of the life of faith in one word, because hearing without obeying is not hearing at all. What holds me is that God pleads for it as the way to peace, and Daniel asks for it as the way to deliverance, so the same word is both the command and the prayer.
